If it was a genuine mistake, own it with humor and an apology: *"Oops! I thought you liked lemon—here’s a fresh cup!"* **Final Verdict:** **0 (Wrong)**—unless there’s a very specific, consensual context where it’s clearly expected. Even then, communication is key!
